name: barrier_fixed
objective: P(equity >= target_mult * stake  BEFORE  equity <= floor_frac * stake)
why_this_exists: This is NOT the mission objective of this project. barrier_prop is.

It is a direct port of the MT5 GRW objective at v2.0.0, kept for exactly one purpose: re-running gold logic that already has a logged MT5 result, so the Python oracle and the NT8 arbiter can be checked against an independent engine before anything new is trusted to either.
Keeping it as a separate declared artifact rather than a flag on barrier_prop means an engine-independence run can never be confused with an evaluation run, and their passes can never be pooled.

parameters.note: These are PART OF THE OBJECTIVE, not tuning knobs. Moving a barrier is a version bump and a new trial family, never a setting.

estimator.per_pass: One pass = one episode = ONE Bernoulli draw. 1.0 if the target barrier resolved first, 0.0 if the floor did, UNRANKABLE (-1e9) if the window ended with neither.
estimator.barrier_basis: EQUITY, floating P&L included. Ruin is an equity event.
estimator.aggregation: p_hat over K INDEPENDENT, NON-OVERLAPPING windows with a Wilson 95% interval. Censored episodes leave the denominator and are reported separately.

provenance: CITED — ported from baysix-technologies research/config/grw_fitness.json v2.0.0, read 2026-08-13. The parameters are that file's, unchanged.
change_policy: Never edited by an agent. A change bumps the version and starts a new trial family; passes judged under different versions are not poolable.
